1.mascotDialogue: The queue — this is what makes it breadth-first, rather than depth-first. Whatever is discovered first is explored first — FIFO order performing the level-by-level spread on its own.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 12 is the guard that keeps BFS from looping forever — mark visited the moment you enqueue, not the moment you dequeue, or the same node will be enqueued again and again.

3.mascotDialogue: 1 and 2 are both distance-1 from the start, so they are visited before 3, which is distance-2 from either. This is the level-order guarantee, in motion.

4.mascotDialogue: One missing line, and BFS's core guarantee — visit each node exactly once — quietly stops holding, for any graph that is not a simple tree.
